marker.description: A metal probe or forceps is pointing to the anterior tip of the tongue.

main_explanation: The specimen is a gross anatomical section of a human tongue, showing the characteristic folds and papillae on the dorsal surface.

supporting_question.question: Which muscle is primarily responsible for the protrusion of the tongue?
supporting_question.explanation: The genioglossus muscle, when contracted, pulls the tongue forward and downward, resulting in protrusion.
